ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first mobile app that helps smallholder farmers diagnose crop diseases using offline computer vision and connects them directly with verified micro-cold storage units to reduce post-harvest loss.
ideas.title: KrishiKavach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Agriculture theme directly with a measurable economic benefit (reduced crop waste and increased farmer income) and leverages an offline-first working demo, matching the proven pattern of winning real-world impact apps.

ideas.pitch: An automated micro-insurance and income-smoothing platform tailored for gig workers and delivery partners, using local weather and traffic APIs to instantly disburse payouts during extreme weather disruptions.
ideas.title: GigSuraksha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the Migrants Livelihood theme by solving a visible financial vulnerability for urban and semi-urban gig workers, aligning with the hackathon's mission of funding high-impact startups.

ideas.pitch: A low-bandwidth, offline-capable diagnostic relay kit interface for rural ASHA workers, allowing rapid vitals syncing and AI-assisted triage when connected to intermittent cellular networks.
ideas.title: GramTeleMed
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Rural Healthcare by empowering frontline health workers with tangible tools, combining a working software prototype with clear, quantifiable metrics on diagnostic speed and referral accuracy.

ideas.pitch: A transparent digital ledger and dynamic pricing aggregator for local agricultural produce that bypasses multiple intermediaries, ensuring farmers receive fair market value in real time.
ideas.title: MandiChain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core objective of increasing farmers' income under the Agriculture theme by delivering a complete transaction workflow that judges can test live.

ideas.pitch: An interoperable electronic health record and predictive triage app for rural community health centers that tracks regional outbreak patterns and medicine inventory in real time.
ideas.title: SwasthyaSahayak
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the Rural Healthcare theme by providing a comprehensive administrative dashboard for small-town clinics, directly mirroring successful civic-tech architecture from past hackathon winners.
